questions.question: List five structural differences between prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
questions.solution_html:
• List five structural differences between prokaryotes and eukaryotes. / [CO3] -
  • Nucleus: Prokaryotes lack a true nucleus; Eukaryotes have a membrane-bound nucleus. [1].
  • DNA: Prokaryotes have circular DNA; Eukaryotes have linear chromosomes. [1].
  • Organelles: Prokaryotes lack membrane-bound organelles; Eukaryotes have them [1].
  • Wall: Prokaryotes have peptidoglycan; Eukaryotes have cellulose or chitin [1]. Cell
  • Size: Prokaryotes are generally smaller than Eukaryotes [1]
